question: Which of the following is a UNESCO recognised dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kalbelia.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• UNESCO has inscribed Kalbelia folk songs and dance in the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity in 2010.</li
